items.q: Sonny would come in and sit in with us sometimes

ctx.x: Something else. I'll never forget the three of them, you know. At one time when I was in Buffalo, two of the bands come into town, like they always used to come into Shea's Buffalo on the circuit, and they stayed at the Vendome Hotel, so Sonny would come in and sit in with us sometimes and so Sonny said, "Hey, you want a job in the band?" I said yeah, you know.
I was just going to ask you. Did you --
